title: The specified integral set comparison lifts to a ring morphism
statement: Let ℓ be prime, E/Q_ℓ finite and X any scheme. Use [def-sfb-integral-comparison-coefficients]. Let a be the natural finite-label representation, c a limit cone over the positive quotient tower, and j its vertex identification with the profinite integers, with the actual quotient projections. Let p and d be the underlying set representations of the pulled-back coefficient sheaf and of its completion. Suppose p sends the adjunction-unit section of each continuous f:S→O_E to X[f], and d sends every completed section to its prescribed finite projection under a. Then the specified natural set isomorphism p.hom ≫ d.inv underlies an additive sheaf morphism which preserves multiplication and one for the given ring-object structures. Invertibility, the normalized projection equation and uniqueness are not conclusions of this lemma.

proof.text: Use [lem-sfb-integral-point-ring-map] to construct the ring map on the profinite point. The existing monoidal adjunction sfbIntegralPointAdjunction lifts to monoid objects by Mathlib Adjunction.mapMon. Transpose the point ring map. To identify the underlying natural transformation, precompose with p.inv and apply the lifted Yoneda equivalence at X[O_E]. The normalization hp identifies p.inv(id) with the unit evaluated at the identity continuous function. The unit equation of the lifted adjunction and the prescribed section formula of the point map identify its image with d.inv(id). This proves the underlying-map identity. The assembly separately proves invertibility and every normalized finite projection.
